t: A&M Canadian Immigration Law: a law firm website that makes immigration pathways clear
body: A&M Canadian Immigration Law Corporation is an immigration law firm in Winnipeg, Manitoba, helping individuals, families and businesses with permanent residence, temporary residence, citizenship, refusals and appeals.
## The challenge

Immigration clients arrive anxious and confused by complex rules. The firm needed a website that explains its services clearly, shows its credentials and keeps clients up to date with fast-changing programs such as the Manitoba Provincial Nominee Program.
## What we built

- **A services directory organised by client goals:** urgent cases, permanent residence, temporary residence and US immigration.
- **A lawyer profile:** credentials, experience and memberships, presented to build trust.
- **Live Manitoba PNP draw tables:** draw dates, numbers and scores for each stream.
- **A news and case-law library:** regular updates that give visitors a reason to return and give search engines fresh content.
- **Illustrated guides:** roadmaps and mind maps that explain pathways at a glance.
- **Google reviews integration:** real client reviews on the website.
## Why it works

Every page starts from a real client question and ends with a clear next step: booking a consultation. Read more in [Website design for immigration law firms in Canada](/blog/immigration-law-firm-website-canada) and [How a clear website turns visitors into clients](/blog/website-that-sells).

t: TrustLayer AI: designing a platform that makes responsible AI simple
body: TrustLayer AI helps companies document, comply with and communicate how they use artificial intelligence.
## The challenge
AI governance is unfamiliar territory for most teams. The product had to turn policies and compliance work into simple, guided tasks, and help companies show customers that they use AI responsibly.
## What we designed

- **AI tool registry:** every AI tool a team uses, with risk levels and data handling.
- **Policy generator:** a step-by-step flow that turns policy writing into short choices.
- **Incident tracking:** a clear way to log and resolve AI-related issues.
- **Trust portal:** a public page where companies share their AI practices with clients.
- **Dashboard and analytics:** status at a glance, with details on demand.
- **Landing page:** explaining the product to buyers in plain language.
## Approach

We designed for calm, factual clarity: summary first, consistent status labels, and accessible components. Read [Designing trust into AI products](/blog/trust-for-ai) and [SaaS dashboard design best practices](/blog/saas-dashboard-ux-best-practices).

t: SocialBoost AI: brand and launch website for an AI social post generator
body: SocialBoost AI is an AI tool that writes scroll-stopping social media posts in seconds for Instagram, Facebook, LinkedIn, X and TikTok.
## The challenge
The product needed to launch with a brand that felt modern and trustworthy, a landing page that converted visitors into sign-ups, and a generator interface simple enough to use in seconds.
## What we delivered

- **Brand identity:** a confident visual system with purple gradients, rounded type and bold headlines.
- **Conversion-focused landing page:** a clear promise, a free start and proof points near every call to action.
- **Post generator UX/UI:** platform selection, post types and tone options in one clean screen.
- **Mobile experience:** the same flow designed for phones.
## Why it works
A consistent brand across the website, app and social posts means people recognise the product before they read its name. Read [Why your brand needs a system, not just a logo](/blog/brand-system).

t: Style.Bd: a mobile marketplace where live shopping meets verified sellers
body: Style.Bd is a fashion marketplace app for buyers in Bangladesh, where most shopping starts on a phone and many purchases begin in a live video.
## The challenge
Buyers needed to discover products, trust new sellers and buy without leaving the app, while sellers needed a way to showcase products live.
## What we designed

- **Home and trending feeds:** discovery built around patterns people know from social apps.
- **Live shopping:** buyers can watch, comment and buy in one place.
- **Verified sellers:** badges and profiles that reduce the worry of buying from someone new.
- **Shop and category browsing:** fast paths to the right products.
- **In-app messaging:** buyers and sellers can talk without switching apps.
## Why it works

Every action sits within thumb reach, and the bottom navigation keeps the key areas one tap away. Read [Designing a live shopping app for mobile-first buyers](/blog/live-shopping-app) and [How much does it cost to build a mobile app?](/blog/mobile-app-cost-usa-canada).

t: Sabbir LIVE: a creator website that turns visitors into followers
body: Sabbir LIVE is a content creator publishing YouTube Shorts, Facebook Reels and TikTok videos.
## The challenge
Videos were spread across several platforms. The creator needed one home that shows the newest content first and turns visitors into followers everywhere.
## What we built

- **A bold, dark brand presence** that matches the energy of the videos.
- **Platform sections** for YouTube Shorts, Facebook Reels and TikTok.
- **Follow and subscribe calls to action** close to every video.
- **A contact page** for collaborations and sponsorships.
## Why it works
Newest content comes first, so returning fans always find something new, and every section leads to a follow button. Read [How to get more leads from your website](/blog/get-more-leads-from-website).

t: Funpark: a social media campaign that keeps a family fun park top of mind
body: Funpark Indoor Amusement Center is a family entertainment venue with trampolines, slides and play areas.
## The challenge
Funpark needed to stay visible every week, fill quieter days and promote seasonal moments without its feed looking repetitive.
## What we created

- **Discount Tuesday:** a recurring weekly offer that followers learn to expect and share.
- **Brand moments:** "Bounce Mode", "All in One Place" and "Everything" posts that show the fun of the venue.
- **Seasonal campaigns:** Christmas and New Year posts that keep the feed warm between offers.
- **Consistent art direction:** big, readable type and real photography of kids and families.
## Why it works

One clear idea per post, real people and a reason to act now. Read [What makes a social post stop the scroll](/blog/scroll-stopping-posts) and our [social media marketing guide](/blog/social-media-marketing-small-business).

t: Immigration consultancy CRM: leads, clients and meetings in one place
body: An immigration consultancy needed one tool to replace scattered spreadsheets, inboxes and calendars.
## The challenge
Leads were slipping through the cracks and the team had no single view of clients, deals, tasks and revenue.
## What we built

- **Leads and deals:** a pipeline that follows each enquiry from first contact to signed client.
- **Clients and projects:** every file, task and document in one place.
- **Meetings calendar:** a monthly view with upcoming appointments.
- **Reports:** revenue by month, lead sources and conversion by stage.
## Why it works

We designed around the team's real workflow, so the CRM matches how people already work. Read [From spreadsheets to one CRM](/blog/one-crm) and [SaaS dashboard design best practices](/blog/saas-dashboard-ux-best-practices).
